---
description: Review implementation and verify the code and generated profile.
mode: agent
---

Review the change against `/docs/requirements.md` and the checklist in
`/docs/code-review.md`. Check correctness, security, error handling, tests,
clarity, duplication, and dependency safety. Run the unit/integration checks and
validate the generated Markdown, including missing facts and secret redaction.
Update `/docs/code-review.md` and `/docs/verification.md` with findings and
actual evidence. Do not hide unresolved issues.
